description: This file defines runtime environment types and functions for logging, error handling, stdout writing, and process exit management, including default and non-exiting runtime configurations.

methods.name: shouldEmitRuntimeLog
methods.description: Determines if runtime logs should be emitted based on environment variables.

methods.name: shouldEmitRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Determines if stdout output should be emitted based on environment variables.

methods.name: isPipeClosedError
methods.description: Checks if an error corresponds to a closed pipe (EPIPE or EIO).

methods.name: hasRuntimeOutputWriter
methods.description: Type guard to check if runtime has a writeStdout method.

methods.name: writeStdout
methods.description: Writes a string to stdout, handling progress line clearing and pipe errors.

methods.name: createRuntimeIo
methods.description: Creates an object with logging, error, stdout, and JSON writing functions.
